repetition_policy: Equal per-process counts in A-before/B/A-after; all first-use ticks included at equal weight. Pooled controls have twice the candidate sample count.
scope: One full tick per independent physical restore. A-before / B / A-after per scenario. All CPU/GPU work and correction included; restore, validation and post-tick observation excluded. Unprofiled comparison with recorded GPU admission; no profiler timings or automatic acceptance.
